report_comment.text: PTPRZ1 encodes receptor-type protein tyrosine phosphatase zeta. MET encodes the hepatocyte-growth-factor receptor tyrosine kinase. The fusion retains the MET intracellular region and occurs in high-grade gliomas. Primary tumor and cell-line analyses showed increased MET expression; engineered fusion expression enhanced MET phosphorylation and glioma-cell migration/invasion. In the historical secondary-glioblastoma discovery cohort, fusion-positive tumors had shorter overall survival than fusion-negative tumors. This was a cohort association rather than a validated prognosis estimate for every current integrated glioma diagnosis.
